key_decisions.decision: Keeps the tension between fulfilling judgment and being judged for the slaughter.
Retains the coarse idiom and wider circle of victims.
Preserves self-initiated fatal fire without added motive.
Preserves the second accession date and both durations.
Preserves the sons’ loss without asserting an unmentioned sacrificial mechanism.
